evidence.detail: Font subsetting system dynamically queries DB for graphemes from card and deck names; no Cherokee font is listed in the PREFER dict or available font set
regenerate_symbols_font() spawns a detached rebuild process, providing some automation, but does not handle the case where a required font file is absent

The subsetting pipeline would include Cherokee graphemes automatically if a Cherokee font file were present, but that font acquisition and the scheduling cadence for rebuilds require a non-trivial design decision

triage.notes: Two distinct sub-tasks: (1) source and add a Cherokee font (e.g. NotoSansCherokee) to the font set in maintenance/fonts.py, and (2) decide on an automated trigger cadence beyond the per-deck-submission hook in shared_web/fonts.py. The per-submission hook already exists; the remaining gap is a missing font file and possibly a periodic scheduled rebuild.
